name: Randomizer
author: nerderror
description: Shuffles missions on the world map, fixed item rewards (optionally story key items, with logic), shop stock, enemies, enemy hats, weapon stats, class perks, prices, dialogue, barks and NPC looks. Two presets: Balanced and Chaos. Same seed = same game. Writes a spoiler log to SWH2ModLoader/Reports/Randomizer.

settings.label: Seed
settings.help: Leave empty for a random seed (it is saved after installing).

settings.label: Preset
settings.help: Sets all options below. Changing any of them by hand switches to Custom.

choices.label: Balanced — plays like the normal game

settings.label: Shuffle missions on the world map
settings.help: Mission markers stay where they are, but start other missions. Story missions, bosses, heists, shops and missions holding story items stay in place.

settings.label: Shuffle fixed item rewards
settings.help: Mission loot, region bounties, world map artifacts/flagships, quest rewards.

settings.label: Shuffle story key items (with logic)
settings.help: Glow rods, heist keys, diving plates and the like move too, but only to places the story reaches earlier than their own, so the game stays beatable. Items the story hands out in cutscenes stay.

choices.label: Balanced (same kind and tier, from other shops)

settings.label: Randomize enemies
settings.help: Enemies in spawn tables (initial spawns and reinforcements) are replaced by enemies from the whole game, without repeats inside a table. Bosses and scripted enemies stay.

choices.label: Balanced (health & damage of the enemy it replaces)
Of the enemy it replaces (no infighting)

settings.label: Chaos limits
settings.help: Chaos stats only. Caps how much stronger an enemy can be than the one it replaces, and stronger enemies come in smaller numbers.

choices.label: Fair (health up to 2x, damage up to 1.5x)
Loose (health up to 3x, damage up to 2x)

settings.label: Shuffle enemy hats
settings.help: Enemies wear (and drop) each other's hats. Every hat still drops from some enemy.

choices.label: Balanced (damage, crit and random damage trade off, total stays)

settings.label: Shuffle class perks
settings.help: Level-up perks move between classes. The starting perk of each class stays.

choices.label: Balanced (same level, abilities with abilities, stat bonuses with stat bonuses)

settings.label: Shuffle dialogue lines
settings.help: Lines in conversations and cutscenes are swapped. Choices and tutorials are not touched.

settings.label: Shuffle battle barks
settings.help: Short lines crew and enemies shout in battle.

settings.label: Shuffle NPC looks
settings.help: Bartenders, shopkeepers and townsfolk in bars and on locations swap models. Characters used in cutscenes keep theirs.
